short: Enhancing Vibrational Light-Matter Coupling Strength beyond
title: Enhancing Vibrational Light-Matter Coupling Strength beyond the Molecular Concentration Limit Using Plasmonic Arrays

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Coupling strength cannot be pushed further by concentration: neat liquid is already the ceiling. A plasmonic array tuned to the same frequency as cavity and molecule should push the coupling above the sqrt(C) limit.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/variable_sweep), n6 (PRC/deposition), n7 (PRC/forming), n8 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: Collective light-matter coupling scales as sqrt(N/V), i.e. sqrt(C), so a neat liquid is the concentration ceiling; Bisht et al. built the analogous cavity-plasmon-TMD hybrid in the visible regime

states.title: Structure state
states.head: The arrays are regular rectangular lattices of uniform gold nanorods of constant width and pitch, length 1100-1500 nm

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: The plasmon resonance red-shifts monotonically with rod length, sweeping across both molecular bands and the FP modes. Cavity-molecule strong coupling gives a Rabi splitting of 101 cm-1 for C=O and 46 cm-1 for C-N.
states.detail: Absorbed: n10 (PRP/value), n11 (PRP/value), n12 (PRP/behavior_class), n13 (PRP/value), n14 (PRP/value), n15 (MEC/pathway), n16 (PRP/value), n17 (MEC/pathway). Premises: A Rabi splitting larger than both the molecular and the cavity linewidth is the criterion for strong coupling; The authors' earlier plasmon arrays ultrastrongly coupled to FP cavities showed the same linewidth narrowing; Multimode Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonian over the 20 lowest cavity modes, coupling read at zero detuning

states.title: Performance state
states.head: At unchanged neat concentration the hybrid delivers ~5x (hexanal) and ~11x (nitrile) the cavity-molecule coupling, beating the sqrt(C) ceiling

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Plasmonic arrays inside an IR cavity raise vibrational light-matter coupling beyond the molecular concentration limit while the cavity tames their radiative losses

nodes.title: evidence, F5, F6
nodes.head: The transmission maps of the rod-loaded cavity show bright bands whose wavenumber shifts monotonically with rod length. The simulated maps (F5d-f) reproduce the branch positions and slopes of the measured maps (F5a-c) panel for panel.
nodes.solves: Rods plus cavity give 2+1 = 3 microcavity-plasmon polaritons with almost linear dispersion in rod length
nodes.op: compare across conditions, overlay model on data, read trend
nodes.note: the grey dots (plasmon absorption maximum) fall from ~2230 cm-1 at 1100 nm to ~1750 cm-1 at 1500 nm; the caption's blue dash-dot polariton guides are not discernible in the packet image panels d-f are simulation output, not an instrument reading; the simulated branches are far sharper than the measured ones and the caption gives simulated thicknesses 10.8 / 8.5 / 10.4 um five magenta points per branch on the ~1750-1850, ~2100-2200 and ~2600 cm-1 branches; the branches bend away from the dotted bare-plasmon diagonal (anticrossing) the F5 caption calls them an artifact of non-ideal polarization alignment; they are as bright as the polariton branches, so branch identification rests on the caption's guides
nodes.detail: o8: The transmission maps of the rod-loaded cavity show bright bands whose wavenumber shifts monotonically with rod length; o9: The simulated maps (F5d-f) reproduce the branch positions and slopes of the measured maps (F5a-c) panel for panel; o10: Measured transmission-peak positions of the rod-cavity system populate three eigenvalue branches of the multimode JC fit; a2: Non-dispersing vertical bands persist in the transmission maps beside the dispersing branches
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n13 (o9, o10, a2).

nodes.title: evidence, F6
nodes.head: In the two hybrid systems the measured peaks again lie on the JC branches, which flatten at the C=O and C-N lines
nodes.solves: The three-component system reaches a resonant coupling strength of about 220 cm-1 (hexanal) and 202 cm-1 (4-butylbenzonitrile)
nodes.note: F6b has ~7 and F6c ~8 branches against ~6 in F6a, i.e. more FP modes in the same range; measured points sit on 3 branches in F6b and 4 in F6c
